pages.text: **Ender Alloy** is made in a **Mixer**: 1 gold ingot + 2 ender pearls with 250 mB of lava. It is the shared late-game material of Ender Engineering and Fluid Armor.

The **Exchanger** swaps blocks without breaking a whole area by hand. Sneak-use a block to choose the replacement, then use a block of the kind you want to replace. Matching, exposed blocks are swapped ring by ring on the clicked face, one ring every half second, out to the radius (**=** and **-** keys, sneak for max/min, 1 to 8).

Each swap costs 2,048 to 16,384 RF from the tool, depending on ring and hardness. It uses one replacement block from your inventory and puts the old block (silk-touched when possible) into it. It stops when RF, blocks or inventory space run out. Protected blocks are skipped.
